title: crumb: how does a running state-mode session autosave back into the vault?
scope: Timer and signal saves from a running supervisor and the Chrome it owns into encrypted per-account vault files.
omissions: Launch, manual CLI close/sync commands and plaintext run handle files
login, capture, check, transfer and profile-mode sessions

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.description: Detached process; timer and signal saves

nodes.label: Owned Chrome
nodes.description: Supervisor's Playwright context, not a peer

notes.title: Save triggers
notes.text: setInterval every --autosave secs (default 30; 0 disables). SIGINT/SIGTERM do a final save; SIGUSR2 saves (non-Windows). Concurrent saves coalesce; unchanged snapshots skipped.

notes.title: Merge and write
notes.text: mergeState(latest, before, after) plus browser hints, written with 'sync' provenance via 0600 temp file + rename. No lock against other writers.

notes.title: Lost-save paths
notes.text: Save errors are only logged. If Chrome's context closes on its own, the supervisor exits with no final save. Vault key: CRUMB_KEY, OS keychain/secret-service, or 0600 key file.
